assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are repository-provided rough intake geometry because official cleared polygons are not yet available.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, transport, green-space, building and phasing conclusions must be recalculated after official polygons arrive; the rough geometry is not an official redline or precise area basis.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use data minimization, opt-in aggregation, purpose limitation and human review as design requirements; operational governance, cybersecurity, accessibility and liability need specialist confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards are reference concepts for professional and community deepening, not autonomous public-sector decisions or approved service contracts.
